# Review packages and release policy

[Project overview](../README.md) · [Documentation](../docs/README.md) · [Local design review](http://localhost:8765/site/)

Separate electrical and enclosure bundles, with reproducible ZIPs and a source-bound manifest.

## Package layout

| Archive | Use |
|---|---|
| `thor-A1-2port-pcb.zip` | Two-port native project, Gerbers/drills, BOM/CPL, drawings and evidence |
| `thor-A1-4port-pcb.zip` | Four-port engineering equivalent; reserved channels remain unverified |
| `thor-A1-housings.zip` | Both housing sizes, clamp, coupons, STEP/STL/3MF and assembly instructions |

`SHA256SUMS` checks the archive bytes. Each archive includes member checksums. [manifest.json](manifest.json) binds public source and generated artifacts to a revision; [release notes](release-notes.md) state its limits.

## Review before publication

Work is developed on a branch and submitted by pull request into `main`. CI validates committed evidence and produces review packages. Tagged releases publish only after review; no automatic merge is used. Current A1 review packages are built from merged `main`; each change passes through a pull request. Existing A0 releases are historical and superseded, including their enclosure handedness and CAN routing.

Generate locally with `.venv/bin/python tools/package_release.py` after validation. ZIPs are CI/release artifacts rather than source-controlled binaries. [Manufacturing instructions](../docs/manufacturing.md) explain quote inputs and outstanding gates.
